team.name: Alec Clausen
team._photo_note: PENDING: headshot or working shot at src/assets/img/team/. The bio without a face is worth a fraction of the bio with one.
team.bio: I got into business at eighteen, running Smoothie King locations. For eleven years my job was to walk into a store that was losing money, sometimes four at once, put the right team in, cut what was bleeding, and rebuild it from the bottom up until it turned a profit and the people working there were glad to be there. Same job now. The asset changed; the work didn't. I've been licensed since 2020, six years as a broker, and most of my experience is agent-side. I'm building the buying side now and I'd rather tell you that than pad a number.

hiddenCosts: Showings on the buyer's schedule, not yours
Keeping the lawn cut and the house clean for every one of them
Maid service or a cleaning crew before photos
A survey, if the lender or buyer wants one
HVAC, plumbing, roof and foundation repairs a buyer's inspector finds
Title search problems that surface late
Loan processing delays on the buyer's side
FHA and VA appraisal conditions that have to be fixed before the loan funds
The lender's own inspection, separate from the buyer's
Renegotiation after the inspection report comes back
A buyer walking away after inspection, putting you back at day one
Having to disclose that inspection report to every buyer who comes after
Every month the house sits, still costing you money
The market moving while you wait

guarantee._README: Alec confirmed both. Do not publish a guarantee he has not agreed to honor.

items.name: The 24-Hour Offer Guarantee
items.body: You'll have a written offer within 24 business hours of us walking the property. If we miss it, we pay you $100. Not a credit, not a discount off something else. We send you $100.

items.name: The Walk-Away Guarantee
items.body: Cancel any time before closing, for any reason or for no reason. No fee, no penalty, no pressure. If you change your mind the day before, you change your mind.
